bio: The inscription 1906 is still to be seen above the timeworn arch at the entrance of this building in the centre of the old town. Having been completely gutted and meticulously rebuilt, the property now houses an invitingly chic, modern restaurant with large windows and an impressive open kitchen. The sophisticated dishes seamlessly highlight select ingredients with modern accents. Diners are offered a choice of various set menus; individual courses can also be ordered à la carte. Recommendations from the short, well curated wine list are always spot on. There is also a brasserie under the same roof....
